entities.summary: Warner Antonio Madrigal is a Dominican former professional baseball pitcher. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Texas Rangers, Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Chunichi Dragons, and in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) for the Uni-President 7-Eleven Lions.
